ripple-reveal.name: ripple-reveal
ripple-reveal.title: Ripple Reveal
ripple-reveal.description: Hide or show a sensitive value with a ripple that starts exactly where you tap. A damped sine swell travels out across the surface and flips the content between its shown and hidden faces as the front passes, with a soft tap and a light haptic.

glass-toggle.name: glass-toggle
glass-toggle.title: Glass Toggle
glass-toggle.description: An on/off switch with a thumb of thick frosted glass. Flip it and the thumb springs across, a pixel moon scatters and reassembles as a pixel sun, and a rim light runs round the glass from cool lilac to warm amber.

bubble-wrap.name: bubble-wrap
bubble-wrap.title: Bubble Wrap
bubble-wrap.description: A sheet of plastic air cells to press or sweep across. Each bubble squashes, pops with a short falling sound and a light haptic tick, and stays flat until the cleared sheet re-inflates in a ripple.

scratch-card.name: scratch-card
scratch-card.title: Scratch Card
scratch-card.description: A foil scratch-off card. Rub the foil away with a finger or cursor to reveal what is underneath, with a scratch texture that follows your speed, foil flakes, and a soft chime when the rest lifts off.

pull-cord.name: pull-cord
pull-cord.title: Pull Cord
pull-cord.description: A ball-chain pull switch for a light. Drag the handle down and the chain feeds out bead by bead with a tick each, then flips with a click on release and swings back to rest.

elastic-slider.name: elastic-slider
elastic-slider.title: Elastic Slider
elastic-slider.description: A slider that thickens under your finger and stretches like rubber past either end, with a soft tick at every detent and a dull thunk at the limits.

time-ring.name: time-ring
time-ring.title: Time Ring
time-ring.description: A 24-hour dial for picking a time range, like a bedtime and wake-up schedule, with rolling digits, a tick per step, a deeper click per hour, and a thunk at the limits.

wheel-picker.name: wheel-picker
wheel-picker.title: Wheel Picker
wheel-picker.description: An iOS-style scroll wheel that coasts with inertia and settles on a row, with a detent tick and a haptic tap for every row that passes the centre.

dynamic-island.name: dynamic-island
dynamic-island.title: Dynamic Island
dynamic-island.description: An iPhone-style pill that morphs between an idle pill, a compact live activity, and an expanded card, with a liquid spring, a sound and a haptic per morph, and swipe up to dismiss.

rotary-knob.name: rotary-knob
rotary-knob.title: Rotary Knob
rotary-knob.description: A hardware-style dial you turn by dragging, scrolling, or with the keyboard, with a tick and a haptic notch on every detent and a thunk at the end stops.

otp-field.name: otp-field
otp-field.title: OTP Field
otp-field.description: A one-time code input with a slot per digit, a tick per keystroke, a cascade on paste, and a shake when the code is wrong.

star-rating.name: star-rating
star-rating.title: Star Rating
star-rating.description: A 1–5 star input you tap, sweep across, or arrow through, with a tick per star, half stars, and a pop when a pick lands.

number-stepper.name: number-stepper
number-stepper.title: Number Stepper
number-stepper.description: A quantity field whose digits roll the way you count, with a click per step, hold-to-accelerate, and a soft wall at the limits.

swipe-actions.name: swipe-actions
swipe-actions.title: Swipe Actions
swipe-actions.description: iOS-style list rows you swipe to reveal actions, with threshold haptics, a full-swipe snap, and keyboard support.

snap-sheet.name: snap-sheet
snap-sheet.title: Snap Sheet
snap-sheet.description: A bottom sheet you drag between snap points, with detent haptics, a rubber band, and flick to close.

tick-ruler.name: tick-ruler
tick-ruler.title: Tick Ruler
tick-ruler.description: A ruler-style number picker you drag or flick, with a click and a haptic tick on every step.

hold-to-confirm.name: hold-to-confirm
hold-to-confirm.title: Hold to Confirm
hold-to-confirm.description: Guard destructive actions behind a press-and-hold fill with rising sound, haptic ticks, and a checkmark.

interactive-sprite.name: interactive-sprite
interactive-sprite.title: Interactive Sprite
interactive-sprite.description: Turn a directional sprite sheet into a character that follows the pointer and returns to rest.

tile-field.name: tile-field
tile-field.title: Tile Field
tile-field.description: Render a theme-aware wordmark with moving tiles, a color wave, and pointer glow.

search-command.name: search-command
search-command.title: Search Command
search-command.description: Search pages and run actions from a polished, keyboard-first command menu.

tailwindcss-buttons.name: tailwindcss-buttons
tailwindcss-buttons.title: Tailwind CSS Buttons
tailwindcss-buttons.description: Browse and copy a responsive gallery of polished Tailwind CSS button styles.

component-sidebar.name: component-sidebar
component-sidebar.title: Component Sidebar
component-sidebar.description: Navigate dense component libraries with tactile, proximity-reactive guide lines.

peeping-button.name: peeping-button
peeping-button.title: Peeping Button
peeping-button.description: Add a shy, cursor-tracking surprise behind a familiar button face.

brand-context-menu.name: brand-context-menu
brand-context-menu.title: Brand Context Menu
brand-context-menu.description: Share copy-ready and downloadable brand assets from a contextual menu.

animated-tabs.name: animated-tabs
animated-tabs.title: Animated Tabs
animated-tabs.description: Switch segmented options with a fluid shared-layout indicator.

theme-toggle.name: theme-toggle
theme-toggle.title: Theme Toggle
theme-toggle.description: Switch between light and dark themes with animated, sound, and haptic feedback.

copy-button.name: copy-button
copy-button.title: Copy Button
copy-button.description: Copy text to the clipboard with visual, sound, and haptic feedback.

email-dock.name: email-dock
email-dock.title: Email Dock
email-dock.description: Highlight and link parts of an email address with dock actions.

stateful-button.name: stateful-button
stateful-button.title: Stateful Button
stateful-button.description: Communicate async loading, success, and error states without leaving the button.

animated-arrow.name: animated-arrow
animated-arrow.title: Animated Arrow
animated-arrow.description: Slide an arrow across its container when its parent is hovered.

scribbled-text.name: scribbled-text
scribbled-text.title: Scribbled Text
scribbled-text.description: Mark inline text with colorful hand-drawn annotations.
